title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
About AlphaSense: 

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Role

AlphaSense is seeking an exceptional engineer to own our Excel plugin strategy, bringing the power of AI-driven market intelligence directly into the workflow of financial professionals worldwide. You'll build the bridge between our cutting-edge AI platform and the tool that millions of analysts, investors, and researchers use every day - Microsoft Excel.

This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of enterprise desktop development, financial technology, and AI. You'll create experiences that feel magical to users - imagine Excel formulas that can query 1.6 billion documents, or financial models that update with real-time market intelligence. Your work will directly impact how the world's leading financial institutions make critical decisions.

Who You Are:

• 5+ years building production software, with significant experience in desktop applications or Office add-ins

• Deep expertise in C#, .NET and modern development practices

• Strong understanding of asynchronous programming, state management, and event-driven architectures

• Experience with enterprise software deployment, updates, and version management

• Track record of building performant applications with excellent error handling and recovery

• Excellence in debugging complex integration issues and memory/performance optimization

• Strong testing philosophy adapted to desktop environments

• Ability to mentor teams and establish development best practices

Preferred:

• Production experience with C#, VSTO, or COM add-ins

• Knowledge of Excel's calculation engine, object model, and common power-user patterns

• Knowledge of AWS

• Understanding of financial modeling, data analysis workflows, or trading systems

• Experience with web development technologies

• Familiarity with financial data formats (XLSX, CSV, JSON) and transformations

• Background in building offline-capable applications with sync mechanisms

• Experience with WebSocket, real-time data feeds, or streaming architectures

Technical Environment

• Visual Studio & Visual Studio Tools for Office (VSTO)

• REST APIs and WebSocket connections to AlphaSense platform

• Complex state management between local and cloud data

• Enterprise authentication (SSO, OAuth, SAML)

• Cross-platform support (Windows and Mac)

• AWS

What You'll Do

• Architect the Excel Experience : Design and build a production-grade Excel plugin that seamlessly integrates AlphaSense's AI capabilities while respecting Excel's performance and stability requirements

• Master Complex Integration : Navigate Excel's object model, calculation engine, and event system to create features that feel native while accessing cloud-based intelligence

• Ensure Enterprise Excellence : Build plugins that work flawlessly across Excel 2016, 2019, and Office 365, handling corporate proxies, SSO, offl

title: Senior Product Manager - Okta Identity Governance
locationText: Bellevue, Washington; Chicago, Illinois; New York +4 more
description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Okta is the industry leader in Identity and Access Management, and Okta Identity Governance (OIG) is one of our fastest-growing products, helping thousands of customers maintain zero-standing privileges, automate access certifications, streamline lifecycle management, and meet their compliance obligations. We are seeking a Senior Product Manager who will be part of an exciting opportunity to take our identity governance product to the next level. Our vision is to enable everyone to safely use any technology using the Okta Identity Cloud. The ideal candidate will be someone with a strong technical background, and a willingness to learn and partner closely with engineers, architects, design, and other cross-functional product teams across Okta. Your primary responsibilities in these areas will include:

• Engage with customers to understand pain points with governance, compliance, and access management, and identify opportunities where Okta can help

• Define and execute the roadmap for the Okta Identity Governance platform

• Set product strategy and vision for your product area and evangelize the strategy to internal and external stakeholders

• Define the product roadmap with the right prioritization trade-offs needed to ensure you are able to execute the product vision

• Lead a scrum team of stellar engineers and deliver key features with high quality in the communicated timelines

• Be a thought leader for your product area, and stay on top of the latest innovations and competitive landscape

• Work with Product Marketing to clearly articulate Okta's differentiation versus market alternatives, and be a thought leader for the product area

Minimum Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

• 5+ years of product management experience, preferably in Enterprise SaaS or IaaS

• Developed a phased roadmap for complex or abstract projects, and executed the roadmap to deliver a product that customers loved

• Customer obsessed, have an owner mindset, and drive towards outcomes with curiosity and team spirit.

• Bachelor's degree or an MBA

Preferred Skills:

• Familiar with Okta and how the Okta technology works for Identity Governance and Access Management

• Direct experience or practical knowledge of identity governance concepts such as access certifications, entitlement management, role-based access control (RBAC), and separation of duties, and familiarity with standards like SCIM and SAML is a plus

• Familiar with the competitive landscape in the identity governance space; especially around offerings such as SailPoint, Saviynt, Microsoft Entra ID Governance, and other IGA and PAM providers in the market

title: Account Executive (m/w/d) im Außendienst (new markets) - Bremen
description:
Salonkee kommt nach Bremen und sucht die erste Person im Vertrieb. Du fühlst dich im Sales zu Hause und hast Lust, ein eigenes Gebiet im Außendienst aufzubauen? Bei uns heißt das: Verantwortung übernehmen, kurze Sales-Zyklen betreuen, ungedeckelte Provision verdienen und echte Entwicklungschancen nutzen.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du verantwortest das Wachstum in deiner Region und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson vor Ort

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Deine Woche planst du eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

- Du gibst dein Wissen weiter - im Roleplay, im Shadowing und im Austausch mit Kolleg:innen, die neu dabei sind.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Nachweisbare Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb mit eigener Abschlussverantwortung über den gesamten Sales-Cycle hinweg, von der Kaltakquise bis zum Closing.

- Hohe Selbststeuerung und Eigenverantwortung - du gehörst zu den ersten Teammitgliedern vor Ort.

- Du bist es gewohnt, an KPIs gemessen zu werden und hast deine eigenen Zahlen stets im Blick.

- Du schaffst es, ein komplexes Produkt verständlich zu vermitteln und dabei zu begeistern.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Klare Entwicklungschancen: Nächste Senioritätsstufen erreichst du mit deiner Performance - simpel gehalten und schnell erreichbar. Außerdem besetzen wir Team-Lead-Rollen bevorzugt aus dem eigenen Team und begleiten den Weg dorthin mit unserer Sales Manager Academy.

- Eine Führungskraft und Kolleg:innen, die dich jederzeit unterstützen.

- Strukturierte Einarbeitung und praxisnahe Begleitung über die ersten Monate hinweg (Ramp-Up Programm).

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

L'annuncio è rivolto a candidati di qualunque genere, età e nazionalità, nel rispetto delle leggi 903/77, 125/91, 215/03 e 216/03.

title: Data Engineer
description:
VAS, a URUS Group company, is looking for a Data Engineer to help design, build, and improve the data solutions that support our global business. Working primarily in Databricks, you’ll develop and maintain pipelines and datasets that power reporting, analytics, and AI/ML workloads.

This role works across both modern and established data technologies, with a focus on improving performance, reliability, data quality, and scalability. We’re looking for someone with strong data engineering fundamentals, hands-on Databricks experience, and a solid understanding of data warehousing and Microsoft-based data environments.

Responsibilities

• Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and datasets in Databricks using Python, Spark, and SQL.

• Develop and support batch and streaming data architectures for reporting, analytics, and AI/ML workloads.

• Troubleshoot and optimize Databricks and existing data integration processes for performance, reliability, and data latency.

• Support and enhance existing SQL Server, SSIS, and SSRS solutions while contributing to ongoing platform modernization.

• Implement data quality checks, validation, cleansing, and data warehousing best practices across data pipelines and reporting environments.

• Integrate Databricks with enterprise applications, databases, and other data sources.

• Partner with business users, analysts, and IT teams to translate reporting and data needs into scalable technical solutions.

• Contribute to continuous improvement through emerging data engineering practices, AI-assisted development tools, documentation, and ongoing learning

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

• Strong hands-on experience with Databricks, including Python, Spark, and Delta Lake.

• Strong SQL Server and data warehousing experience, including T-SQL.

• Experience with SSIS and SSRS.

• Experience with Microsoft Azure; Microsoft Fabric is a plus.

• Experience using AI-assisted development tools as part of the engineering workflow.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

title: Senior Technical Specialist Architect
description:
Responsibilities
Peraton 's Department of the Interior (DOI), U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS), and NOAA's National Marine Fisheries Service (NMFS) have identified a critical gap in the federal government's ability to conduct comprehensive Endangered Species Act (ESA) research. While FWS operates an authoritative web-based platform for managing data for terrestrial and freshwater species, it does not currently include NMFS marine and anadromous species data forcing agencies to rely on separate, manual processes. This program closes that gap by integrating marine and anadromous species data into the existing FWS platform, creating a single, unified experience for all ESA-listed species.
Peraton is seeking a Senior Technical Architect to support system integration design, technical documentation, and interoperability testing architecture on a federal data migration program. Working closely with the Technical Architect SME, you will lead key technical design activities and serve as a technical reviewer and documentation lead across the project.
This is a fully remote position supporting a 12-month period of performance with potential for follow-on work and possible placement in other programs across Peraton at the conclusion of the program.
Work Location : Remote
Day To Day Roles and Responsibilities

• Support the Technical Architect SME in system architecture design, integration planning, and technical decision documentation

• Lead the design and documentation of source-to-target mapping specifications for ETL pipeline development

• Design the application integration architecture for federal species data, including API endpoint specifications, data access patterns, and decision logic integration points

• Develop and maintain technical architecture documentation including integration diagrams, data flow diagrams, and API specifications

• Lead interoperability testing architecture design, defining test coverage for API connectivity, authentication, data exchange protocols, metadata alignment, and end-to-end data flow

• Support the development of the production migration runbook, documenting technical cutover steps, validation checks, deployment sequences, and rollback procedures

• Conduct technical review of all code and pipeline deployments, enforcing peer review requirements

• Support compliance validation from a technical perspective, validating decision logic correctness and consultation routing accuracy

Qualifications
Basic Qualifications

• Bachelors degree and 12 years professional experience or a Masters degree and 10 years professional experience or an Associates degree and 16 years professional experience; or a high school diploma/equivalent and 18 years’ professional experience.

• U.S. Citizenship required; must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance

• Extensive experience in systems architecture or technical design on federal IT programs

• Experience designing API integration architectures and data flow documentation for federal systems

• Strong knowledge of federal IT governance frameworks and hybrid AWS cloud platform standards

• Experience with interoperability testing design and technical documentation

• Experience developing production migration runbooks including cutover steps, validation checks, and rollback procedures

• Familiarity with Git or equivalent version control platforms for technical review and code deployment oversight

• Experience with REST API design standards and API gateway patterns for federal system integration

• Proficiency in producing architecture artifacts including integration diagrams and API specifications

Preferred Qualifications

• Master's degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or Enterprise Architecture or a related technical field is strongly preferred

• TOGAF or equivalent architecture certification

• Experience with Databricks, Delta Live Tables, or cloud ETL pipeline architectures on AWS

• Familiarity with FedRAMP, FIS

title: Supply Risk Planner
description:
The role: What's in the Box

As a Supply Risk Planner, you will support the day-to-day execution of supply risk tracking and operational planning across your assigned ingredient category. You will focus on maintaining key risk databases, tracking supplier commitments, and identifying short-term inventory and supply constraints before they impact customer delivery or menu availability.

Sitting within the Supply Risk & Planning team and reporting  to the Associate Director of Supply Risk & Planning, you will drive routine risk analysis, monitor category metrics, and proactively evaluate emerging supply risks. You will act as a pragmatic problem solver and key operational liaison with Strategic Sourcing, SCO, Demand Planning, and Menu Planning across our EU markets.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

Long-Term Supply Risk & Planning (T-12 to T-52)

• Volume Commitments: Track supplier volume commitments for your category, identifying under- or over-committed volumes, and coordinate with Strategic Sourcing and Menu Planning to execute mitigation steps.

• Menu Planning Constraints: Maintain and update the catalogue of category supply constraints (e.g., SKU volume caps, supplier lead-time limits, minimum recipe frequency requirements) that feed into Menu Planning cycles.

• SKU Portfolio Reviews: Provide accurate data and category analysis for quarterly SKU portfolio reviews, ensuring active SKUs align with business performance and customer requirements.

Mid-Term Supply Risk & Planning (T-0 to T-12 - Menu Planned, Not Yet Live)

• Supply Volume Tracking: Monitor SKU and supplier-level forecast shifts in your category to identify emerging availability risks that require immediate mitigation.

• SKU Risk Database: Maintain the category SKU risk database and follow established risk management protocols. Partner with Strategic Sourcing, SCO, and FSQA to maintain updated risk scores per SKU and engage Menu Planning when demand steering is needed.

• Waste at Risk: Track waste-at-risk projections for your category. When waste projections exceed acceptable limits, engage Demand Planning, SCO, and Menu Planning to initiate corrective actions before menus go live.

• Inventory on Hand: Monitor inventory levels against forecasted demand across fulfillment centers, partnering with SCO and 3PW teams to maintain healthy stock parameters.

• SKU Caps Management: Track the operational impact of SKU caps on recipe options. Where caps overly constrain customer menu variety, discuss with Strategic Sourcing, SCO and Menu Planning to reduce the customer impact.

• Allocation Execution: Support allocation decisions across markets when a known SKU shortage occurs ahead of menu lock-in, following established business allocation logic.

• NID Go-Live Readiness: Perform final operational risk checks with SCO to verify that all approved NIDs within your category are correctly enabled for ordering prior to menu launch.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

• 2+ years of experience in supply chain planning, procurement operations, or a related field, backed by a degree in Supply Chain, Business, Economics, or a relevant discipline.

• Data Proficiency: Proficient in working with spreadsheets (Google Sheets) using formulas, lookup functions, and pivot tables to analyze operational datasets.  

• Tooling & AI Usage: Exposure to SQL or BI reporting tools (such as Databricks) is helpful, alongside a strong interest in utilizing AI to streamline analysis and routine tasks.  

• Pragmatic Problem Solving: Hands-on mindset with an ability to break problems down into clear, manageable steps and propose practical solutions. 

• Supply Chain Basics: Good understanding of fundamental supply chain concepts, including lead times, MOQs, stock levels, and volume forecasts.

• Prior experience in food production, meal-kit operations, FMCG, or perishable inventory environments is a strong plus.

title: Data Center Operations Technician
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Datacenter Operations Technician at SpaceXSI, you will be responsible for the health of our server and network infrastructure for Data Centers and Global Points of Presence. You will be responsible for our two most important data center operations metrics: mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to repair (MTTR). You are great at following directions, are a fast learner and are super attentive to details. You are accessible via cell phone and willing to get onsite when there are emergencies as needed. You understand all aspects of the equipment you are responsible for to drive efficiencies and optimizations where necessary to simplify and improve our server intake and repair processes.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Report to the job site during initial construction and report back to the engineering team as required.

• Performing troubleshooting and monitoring of the servers and network in our data centers and global points of presence

• Rack and stack of data center network equipment 

• Maintain Warehouse inventory and asset management using our internal application.

• Labeling and troubleshooting for fiber/optics cables

• Power supply cabling, installation, troubleshooting and repair

• Installation of racks, servers and switches; this includes staging racks in place, cabling, power up and handoff of hardware to the provisioning team for customer capacity allocation.

• Manage, response and resolution of data center operations tickets used cross functionally within SpaceXSI via Jira.

• Create and Maintain documentation of tasks and standard operating procedures

• Receipt and Decommissioning of data center hardware.

• Vendor returns for infrastructure under and out of warranty

• Manage spare parts inventory within the data center

• Define, design, and implement network layouts and solutions within our data centers

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate

• 2+ years of experience working with server, storage, compute and network hardware

• 2+ Years of experience troubleshooting and repairing servers and networking infrastructure

• 2+ years of experience in Inventory Management, and ordering, receiving and shipping server and network equipment

• Position is subject to pre-employment drug and random drug and alcohol testing

• Position is subject to pre-employment and annual post employment background checks

• Physical Requirements:

• Work is often performed in tight quarters and physical dexterity is necessary to perform job functions

• Ability to lift up to 35lbs. unassisted

• Comfortable working at elevated heights (up to 50 feet) with appropriate safety gear

• Comfortable working in an environment requiring exposure to noise

• Available to work evenings and weekends, as the schedule varies depending on site operational needs; flexibility is required

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Strong Linux skills including: 

• Navigating the system’s directories and filing system

• Manipulating files in the Linux shell

• User permission configuration

• Package installation and software management 

• Ability to identify and apply different filesystem types

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
About Voltus
Voltus is a leading company for Distributed Energy Resources (DERs). Our mission is to be the platform that fulfills the promise of the energy transition. The Voltus platform connects any DER to any energy market across the US and Canada, providing flexibility, reliability, and resilience to the grid while generating revenue for our partners.

We hire teammates who are bright, gritty, and good and who have a genuine passion for delivering a cleaner energy future and for working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. We are a remote and virtual company, distributed across US, Canada, and abroad.
The Role
Voltus is hiring for multiple roles at the senior level on several teams. As a Senior Engineer you will find a home on one of these teams and assume a technical leadership role in our backend solutions and front end technologies where appropriate to the team. You'll join a fully remote team tackling complex energy industry challenges, collaborating with experienced engineers on our modern tech stack, and contributing to core systems that decarbonize the grid.
Your work will involve building core backend logic, APIs, designing data pipelines, or creating customer interfaces. A strong candidate can speak to their alignment with our core values of bright, gritty, and good, and you want to work with others like you in a highly collaborative environment.
Technologies We Use
We build scalable software using Python, Postgres, Go, FastAPI, Temporal, Delta Lake, Clickhouse, Typescript, and React, running our services using Docker and the HashiCorp stack on AWS. We do not expect candidates to have a background in every tool listed here; instead, we place a high value on strong foundational programming skills and a genuine eagerness to learn and grow. Successful candidates can demonstrate significant depth in some of core technologies.
Responsibilities

• Assume a technical leadership role, with other senior engineers, for the team’s solutions bringing past experiences to improve our coding practices and team principals and operating procedures.

• Represent engineering in close collaboration with our product and design teams and internal stakeholders including technical requirements gathering

• Author and support process and design documentation and exemplify best practices by example

• Work principally in the backend and data handling layers of our technology stack with front end development on occasion

Qualifications

• Minimum of 8 years of experience as a code-contributing engineer

• Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent combination of education and experience, in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Multiple years of experience working in one or more of our foundational backend technologies and with databases

• An empathetic individual who cares about engineering culture with demonstrated contributions to team culture and engineering best practices

• A strong collaborator who understands what it means to be a force multiplier

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

• A genuine passion for our mission to create a cleaner, more resilient energy future.

• Authorization to work in the US or Canada without sponsorship

**Please include a link to your GitHub account in your application (in the “links” section). Applications without a GitHub account will not be considered**

Please note that at this time, we do not sponsor visas or transfers for new hires . Voltus teammates need to be authorized to work from their home location (in the US or Canada, unless otherwise indicated on the role description).

Additionally, while Voltus is an all-remote workplace, we have limitations on where employees are able to work for regulatory and security reasons. We expect that Voltans are working primarily from their home country. Working while traveling to other countries must be approved as per our Global Remote Travel Policy.

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

In this role, you will be a key driver of our mission to reimagine energy and make net-zero a reality for everyone. You will empower our clients, partners, and colleagues in French-speaking markets to not only understand our platform but to master it - including the AI-powered capabilities we are continuously building and rolling out. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. Our sales team members work hand-in-hand with large organisations around the world to keep their digital environments protected. We educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients in their journey to security.

As part of our sales team, you are empowered with systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won't find someone at Cloudflare that isn't committed to your success - with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. 

As a member of our sales team, you are motivated by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats.

This position has working hours Monday to Friday 09:00 a.m. to 06:00 p.m. Occasionally, we support our customers during the weekends for specific changes that need to be done outside of their business hours. Travel is expected at 30%.

About the role:

AST SpaceMobile is seeking a detail-oriented  Lead Master Data & Configuration Management Specialist to bridge engineering configuration data with supply chain operations across a multinational business environment. The Lead Specialist ensures that every inventory item is accurately coded, classified, and linked across Enterprise Resource Planning and Warehouse Management Systems. About the Role
At BukuWarung , we are building the financial backbone for millions of underserved merchants. As an SDE II in Lending Engineering, you will design and scale systems that power our lending products-ensuring a seamless user experience, strong data consistency, and reliable integrations with external financial partners.
Your work will directly impact how merchants access and interact with credit, from application to disbursement and repayment. Beyond building features, you will help lay the foundation for a scalable lending platform that can evolve toward automated underwriting and intelligent decisioning.
The Mission
We are entering a critical phase where scalability, reliability, and data integrity are essential. You will work within a Hexagonal Architecture to ensure our lending platform can scale sustainably while remaining resilient and maintainable.
Our goal is to build a system that not only handles growing transaction volumes but also integrates deeply with partners and internal data sources-ultimately enabling us to develop our own underwriting capabilities and automate credit decisions at scale.
What You'll Do

• Ensure Data Consistency: Develop systems that maintain strong data integrity across distributed services, especially in financial transactions and state transitions.

• Partner Integrations: Build and manage robust integrations with external partners such as payment gateways, banks, and credit bureaus.

• Platform Evolution: Contribute to the foundation for underwriting systems, enabling future automation of credit risk assessment and decisioning.

• System Reliability: Improve fault tolerance, idempotency, and recovery mechanisms to ensure reliable financial operations.

• Data & Storage: Own schema design and manage database evolution using PostgreSQL and Flyway, ensuring performance and correctness at scale.

• Event-Driven Systems: Leverage Kafka for asynchronous processing, auditability, and decoupled service communication.

• Quality & Mentorship: Write clean, testable code and raise engineering standards through thoughtful code and design reviews.

What We're Looking For

• Experience: 3-6 years of backend engineering, with experience in distributed systems or financial domains preferred.

• Reactive & Async Processing: Familiarity with asynchronous or reactive programming (WebFlux, Kafka-driven systems); R2DBC is a plus.

• Architecture: Solid understanding of Hexagonal/Clean Architecture and event-driven design patterns.

• Data & Transactions: Experience working with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and handling transactional integrity in distributed systems.

• Cloud & Infrastructure: Comfortable working within AWS (S3, Lambda, Secrets Manager) and containerized environments (Docker).

• Integration Experience: Hands-on experience integrating with external APIs or third-party systems in a reliable and secure manner.

title: Enterprise Account Manager (Strategic Renewals) - US
description:
About Flosum

Every large company now runs critical parts of its business on Salesforce: sales, service, financial data, patient records, citizen services. When a release breaks something or data goes missing, revenue stops and regulators call. Flosum is the platform these companies trust to ship changes safely, protect their data, and recover fast.
We are in the middle of the most exciting chapter in our history. Our customers have relied on our Salesforce-native platform for years. Now we are bringing them a new cloud-native platform they can run on AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or on-premises. We have also launched sandbox management built for the AI era, so teams can test AI agents such as Agentforce on production-ready environments in minutes instead of days.
Our customers include some of the most demanding enterprises in banking, insurance, healthcare, the public sector, and technology. They don’t buy us casually, and they don’t leave us casually. Your job is to make sure they never want to.

The role
You will own a book of enterprise accounts and one number: retained revenue. You decide which accounts need you most this week, and you go there. This is a commercial role. You will spend your time with executives, not running support tickets.

What you will do

• Own renewals across your book, from strategic accounts to smaller ones, and protect every dollar of recurring revenue.

• Build relationships with the executives who decide: CIOs, CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and heads of Salesforce platforms. Reach past your champion when the account needs it.

• Turn red accounts green. Spot risk early, build a save plan, and run it with urgency.

• Move customers from our Salesforce-native products to our cloud-native platform, and make the business case for why it matters to them.

• Defend your accounts against competitors, in-house builds, and new enterprise architectures.

• Pull the right people in. Hold product, support, engineering, and customer success accountable for what your customers need.

• Find expansion opportunities and hand them to our sales team with a clear plan.

• Run your book with discipline: accurate forecasts, clean renewal pipeline in Salesforce, no surprises.

Requirements
What you bring

• 7+ years in enterprise account management, renewals, or customer-facing sales at a B2B software company.

• You have carried a significant book of business (ideally $5M+ in annual recurring revenue) with individual accounts above $250K.

• You have sold or renewed complex IT solutions: DevOps, data protection, security, infrastructure, or developer platforms. Technical buyers trust you.

• A track record of saving at-risk renewals by going to the executive level, with the numbers to prove it.

• Commercial intensity. You negotiate well, you push for multi-year terms, and you are comfortable with hard conversations about price and value.

• You know how NRR and GRR are calculated and how your work moves them.

• Clear, concise writing and speaking. You can brief a CIO in five minutes.

• Experience in the Salesforce ecosystem is a strong plus.

Benefits

Why join now

• You will work with customers at the moment they move to the cloud. Few account managers get to shape a transition this large.

• Our products sit in the path of AI adoption. Every company deploying AI agents on Salesforce needs to test, release, and protect them safely.

• You will have real ownership, direct access to leadership, and the room to build how account management works here.

• Competitive base plus variable compensation tied to retention.

title: AI Engineer
description:
About Bizmoni Corp.
Bizmoni is building an AI Business Network designed to help people and businesses connect, earn, learn, and grow in the AI era.
As a seed-stage, pre-revenue company, we are strengthening our platform, growing our global ecosystem, and laying the foundations for future funding and scale. This is an opportunity to join an entrepreneurial, international team and help shape both the product and the business.
About the Role
Architecture and platform build

• Design and build our LLM infrastructure from scratch: model serving, orchestration, data pipelines, vector storage and observability.

• Make and document key build-vs-buy decisions, including hosted APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) versus self-hosted open-weight models (Llama, Mistral, Qwen).

• Stand up scalable, cost-efficient inference using tools such as vLLM, TGI or Triton, on GPU and CPU infrastructure.

• Build the cloud foundations on [AWS / Azure / GCP] using infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or similar), Docker and Kubernetes.

LLM application engineering

• Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines: ingestion, chunking, embeddings, hybrid search and re-ranking.

• Develop agentic workflows, tool use and function calling for production use cases.

• Fine-tune and adapt models where it adds value (LoRA/QLoRA, PEFT), and know when prompting or retrieval is the better answer.

• Expose AI capabilities through well-designed Python APIs (FastAPI or similar) for product and engineering teams.

Quality, reliability and safety

• Build evaluation frameworks to measure accuracy, hallucination, latency and cost, and use them to gate releases.

• Implement monitoring, tracing and alerting for LLM services (e.g. LangSmith, Langfuse, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana).

• Put guardrails in place for data privacy, prompt injection, PII handling and GDPR compliance.

• Own CI/CD and MLOps practices for models, prompts and pipelines.

Leadership and collaboration

• Set coding standards, write clear technical documentation and review code.

• Partner with product, data and engineering leads to turn business problems into shipped AI features.

• Help shape future AI hiring and mentor engineers as the team grows.

What you'll bring

•
Expert, hands-on Python. 5+ years writing production Python daily: async, typing, packaging, testing (pytest) and performance profiling. You write the code, not just the design doc.

•
Built LLM systems in production. At least 2 years shipping LLM-powered products to real users, including at least one platform or major system you built from scratch.

•
Infrastructure depth. Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes and at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP), plus infrastructure-as-code.

•
Model serving and optimisation. Practical knowledge of inference servers, GPU utilisation, batching, quantisation and caching to manage latency and cost.

•
RAG and data. Hands-on with embeddings and vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant or similar) and building reliable data pipelines.

•
ML fundamentals. Solid understanding of transformers, tokenisation and fine-tuning, with experience using PyTorch and Hugging Face.

•
Engineering discipline. CI/CD, observability, API design and writing software others can maintain.

•
Ownership. Comfortable making architectural calls with incomplete information, explaining trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders, and working without a ready-made playbook.

Nice to have

• Experience as the first or founding AI/ML engineer at a start-up or scale-up.

• Agent frameworks and protocols such as LangGraph, LlamaIndex, DSPy or Model Context Protocol (MCP).

• Distributed training or multi-GPU work (DeepSpeed, FSDP, Ray).

• Working in a regulated sector (fintech, healthcare, public sector) and familiarity with the EU AI Act.

• Some Rust, Go or TypeScript alongside Python.

• Open-source contributions, published projects or technical writing in the LLM space.
